title: Deploy to Production
content:
1. Ensure all tests pass on main branch.
2. Create a release tag: git tag v<version>
3. Push the tag: git push origin v<version>
4. Monitor GitHub Actions deploy-prod workflow.
5. Verify health endpoint post-deploy: GET /health
6. Announce in #deployments Slack channel.

title: Incident Response Runbook
content:
1. Acknowledge the alert in PagerDuty.
2. Join #incident-response Slack channel.
3. Assign Incident Commander (IC).
4. Identify affected systems using the log analyzer.
5. Communicate status every 15 minutes.
6. Write post-mortem within 48 hours of resolution.

title: Database Backup and Restore
content:
Backup: pg_dump -U postgres mydb > backup.sql
Restore: psql -U postgres mydb < backup.sql
Verify: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM critical_table;
Schedule: Backups run nightly at 02:00 UTC via cron.

title: On-Call Handoff Checklist
content:
1. Review open alerts and incidents.
2. Check deployment queue — any pending prod deploys?
3. Review anomaly scores in log analyzer (score > 75).
4. Brief incoming on-call engineer on active issues.
5. Update on-call rotation in PagerDuty.

title: Rollback Procedure
content:
1. Identify the last stable release tag.
2. Trigger deploy workflow with previous tag.
3. Monitor health endpoint: GET /health
4. Announce rollback in #deployments.
5. Open a bug report for the regression.
